title: AI on H&E slides captures MYC-rearrangement morphology and prognosis in B-cell lymphoma
summary: A multiple-instance deep learning model was trained on 1035 H&E slides to identify MYC rearrangement, from a collection of 2018 annotated DLBCL/HGBCL slides, and tested on an external cohort of 499. The score was associated with overall and progression-free survival, confirmed in a further 484-case cohort without FISH labels, and remained prognostic after adjusting for IPI factors. Scores correlated with MYC and BCL2 expression and microenvironment features.
ai_technology: Multiple-instance deep learning on H&E whole-slide images
